3.head: test/static-dashboard-integration
3.title: 验证静态看板的 PR 与 CI 报告联动

4.author: zhaozhaozz
4.body:
## Summary

The Node.js and Python coverage summaries (`coverage/summary.json`, `coverage/python/summary.json` and every `groups/**/summary.json`) now include a `sources` list: each measured source file's repository-relative path and its own totals (lines and branches, plus functions for Node.js), sorted by path.

A dashboard reading these summaries could show totals and directories but not the files inside them. With `sources`, a directory tree can be expanded down to a single file. The per-file totals come from the same records the summary adds up, so they sum exactly to its totals. Test sources stay excluded.

## Verification

- `node --test scripts/coverage-summary.test.mjs scripts/python-coverage-summary.test.mjs scripts/coverage-report.test.mjs scripts/coverage-job-summary.test.mjs`: 22 passed.
- `node --test .ci/ci-contract.test.mjs`: 11 passed.
- On the UT coverage data from a recent main run:
  - Node.js: 493 sources whose line totals sum exactly to the summary (94,259 / 129,378).
  - Python: 69 sources.
  - The addition is about 110 KB for Node.js and 13 KB for Python before indentation.
4.head: board/coverage-file-totals
4.title: feat(coverage): record each measured file's totals in the summaries
